Battle of Caporetto.subject: Important Days
Battle of Caporetto.question: It was censored by the state and suppressed; it was finally published in _____
Battle of Caporetto.fact: It was censored by the state and suppressed; it was finally published in 1980.

Battle of Caporetto.subject: Important Days
Battle of Caporetto.question: The battle also features prominently in the novel Questa storia by _____
Battle of Caporetto.fact: The battle also features prominently in the novel Questa storia by Alessandro Baricco.

Battle of Caporetto.subject: Important Days
Battle of Caporetto.question: Today, a museum in the town of Kobarid is dedicated to the _____ in general, and the Caporetto Battle in particular
Battle of Caporetto.fact: Today, a museum in the town of Kobarid is dedicated to the Isonzo Battles in general, and the Caporetto Battle in particular.
